cohort: 3341 Queensland caregivers with infants approximately 3 months old
finding: Several factors were statistically significant predictors for breastfeeding cessation at 8 weeks, including young maternal age, single status, lower education level, smoking, being a public patient, higher pre-pregnancy BMI, male infant sex, caesarean delivery, in-hospital formula supplementation, admission to a neonatal nursery, dummy use, and infant sleep location.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was a statistically significant predictor for breastfeeding cessation at 8 weeks.
